title: curie <tier> callers --json
description: The agent-facing payload of `curie <tier> callers <agent> --surface KIND=ADDRESS`: the dry-run plan, or the surface and its caller list as the API stored them (ADR 0175). `allowed_callers` is null when the surface carries no list, meaning everyone may talk to the bot through it; otherwise it is the exact caller ids that may, and anyone else gets no reply. `changed` is false for a show (no `--set` or `--clear`) and true when this invocation wrote.

adapter.description: The identity this surface speaks through (ADR-0168 decision 3), as the API reads it back: `default` for a Slack surface with none named, or null for a non-Slack surface with no route.

allowed_callers.description: The exact caller ids that may talk to the bot through this surface, or null when everyone may.
